scenario.topic: Select the ethical guidelines for using generative AI in coursework

options.name: Mandatory AI Disclosure and Citation
options.upside: Promotes honesty and clear attribution of AI contributions.
options.concern: May increase workload for instructors verifying AI use.

options.name: Prohibit Generative AI in Individual Assignments
options.upside: Simplifies evaluation by excluding AI-generated content.
options.concern: Limits students’ opportunity to learn responsible AI use.

options.name: Allow AI Use with Reflective Reporting
options.upside: Encourages critical thinking about AI’s role in work.
options.concern: May complicate grading due to varied AI involvement.

options.name: Integrate AI Literacy and Usage Training

attrs.collaboration_policy: guided AI use with instructor support

options.upside: Supports ethical AI use through education and guidance.
options.concern: Requires additional resources for training and monitoring.

shared_context: The group must select ethical guidelines for using generative AI in coursework to ensure academic integrity and fairness. The guidelines should address transparency, originality, collaboration, and appropriate AI tool usage.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a junior faculty member focused on maintaining strict academic standards.
personas.private_goal: Ensure coursework remains free from AI-generated content to preserve originality.

A.reason_for: Promotes honesty and clear attribution of AI contributions, which supports transparency.
A.reason_against: May increase workload for instructors verifying AI use, which could be burdensome.

B.reason_for: Simplifies evaluation by excluding AI-generated content, ensuring originality and fairness.

C.reason_for: Encourages critical thinking about AI’s role in work.
C.reason_against: May complicate grading due to varied AI involvement, risking inconsistent assessments.

D.reason_for: Supports ethical AI use through education and guidance.
D.reason_against: Requires additional resources for training and monitoring, which may not be feasible.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a senior professor passionate about integrating technology responsibly in education.
personas.private_goal: Promote transparency and clear attribution in AI-assisted coursework.

A.reason_for: Mandatory AI disclosure fosters honesty and clear attribution, aligning with academic integrity.

B.reason_against: Restricts students’ ability to engage with AI tools responsibly.

C.reason_for: Reflective reporting encourages critical engagement with AI.
C.reason_against: Grading may be complicated by varied AI involvement.

D.reason_against: Needs extra resources and may delay implementation.

personas.name: Nina
personas.background: Nina is a graduate teaching assistant interested in balanced AI integration.
personas.private_goal: Encourage responsible AI use while maintaining originality in coursework.

A.reason_for: Clear AI attribution promotes transparency and honesty.

B.reason_against: Limits learning opportunities with AI tools.

C.reason_for: Reflective reporting fosters critical thinking about AI’s role.

D.reason_against: Requires resources that may not be available.

personas.name: Omar
personas.background: Omar is an instructional designer focused on student support and ethical technology use.
personas.private_goal: Implement AI literacy training to empower students with ethical AI skills.

B.reason_against: Restricts students’ ability to learn responsible AI use.

C.reason_for: Reflective reporting encourages thoughtful AI use.

D.reason_for: Training builds ethical AI skills and supports guided use.

personas.name: Zara
personas.background: Zara is a curriculum coordinator advocating for nuanced AI integration in assignments.
personas.private_goal: Balance AI use with originality through reflective practices.

C.reason_for: Reflective reporting encourages critical engagement with AI.

personas.name: Eli
personas.background: Eli is a technology integration specialist focused on ethical AI education.
personas.private_goal: Promote AI literacy and responsible usage through training programs.

D.reason_for: Training empowers ethical AI use and guided support.

personas.name: Tara
personas.background: Tara is an academic integrity officer committed to upholding fairness and transparency.
personas.private_goal: Ensure clear AI disclosure to maintain academic honesty.

A.reason_for: Mandatory AI disclosure promotes honesty and clear attribution.

C.reason_for: Reflective reporting encourages transparency and critical thinking.
